meta.purpose: Verified community profile dataset for the Shenandoah map Communities mode demographic strip.
meta.geography: Virginia place (Census place, summary level 160), including incorporated towns and census-designated places in Shenandoah County
meta.population_series: ACS B01003 place estimate. The annual population estimates program was not used.
meta.retrieval: U.S. Census Bureau data.census.gov table API for ACSDT5Y2024 and ACSST5Y2024

future_display.independence: The profile strip is independent of subdivision metrics and membership.
